name: Ride Along
body:
As your ally moves, you grab onto their belt and hang on.

Prerequisites: Character level 5th, elfling.

Benefit: When an ally larger than you, able to carry half your total weight, and within 5 feet of you moves, you can also move up to the same distance along the exact same path. You still draw attacks of opportunity for moving in this way.
